article_notes: 87 dogs with B. rossi (smear, confirmed by PCR-RLB) at Onderstepoort (OVAH), 2005 biomarker cohort; serum cPL (Spec cPL) on admission. The samples come from the 2005 prospective OVAH biomarker study (protocol V074/05), the article does not say whether these dogs were reported elsewhere, but overlap with other articles from that 2005 OVAH biomarker study is likely. SIRS by Okano criteria; SIRS status was available for 85 dogs (53 + 32). Mortality: 6 dogs died or were euthanised for poor prognosis (follow-up to discharge or death). Spearman correlations of cPL with rectal temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, neutrophil counts, enzymes and hormones (Table 1) are associations between two markers, not with a severity measure, and were not extracted. The comparison of cPL between dogs with and without pancreatitis-compatible GI signs (P = 0.51) is not a severity comparison and was not extracted.

severity_definitions.label: non-survivors vs survivors
severity_definitions.definition: Dogs that died of the infection or were euthanised for a poor prognosis vs dogs that survived, during hospitalisation (to discharge or death). Dogs euthanised for other reasons were excluded.
severity_definitions.quote: A total of six dogs (6.9%) died as a result of the infection or were euthanised based on a poor prognosis.

severity_definitions.label: SIRS vs no SIRS
severity_definitions.definition: SIRS present if two or more of: WCC >12 000/uL or <4000/uL or >=10% band cells; rectal temperature <37.8 or >39.7 C; heart rate >=160/min; respiratory rate >=40/min (Okano et al.), at admission.
severity_definitions.quote: Dogs were classified as meeting the criteria for SIRS if two or more of the following parameters had been met, as described by Okano et al.:

associations.marker_as_reported: serum canine pancreatic-specific lipase (cPL, Spec cPL, ug/L)
associations.quote: Serum cPL concentrations were not significantly different between non-survivors and survivors (P = 0.74; Figure 1)
associations.note: Per-group values shown only in a boxplot (Figure 1).

associations.marker_as_reported: serum cPL > 400 ug/L (range consistent with pancreatitis)
associations.statistic: Three of the six non-survivors had cPL > 400 ug/L; 24 (28%) of all dogs at admission
associations.quote: Three of the six dogs that died had a serum cPL concentration > 400 µg/L.
associations.note: Counts printed as words in the text. The number among survivors is not printed (not computed).

associations.marker_as_reported: serum canine pancreatic-specific lipase (cPL, Spec cPL, ug/L)
associations.quote: The median concentration of serum cPL in dogs with SIRS was 158 µg/L (interquartile range: 52.5 µg/L – 571.5 µg/L; n = 53), which was significantly higher than in dogs without SIRS (75 µg/L; interquartile range: 50.3 µg/L – 131.8 µg/L; n = 32) (P = 0.018; Figure 3).
